name: word-rotate
title: Word Rotate
description: Swaps one word for the next with a short slide and fade. Screen readers get the whole list once.

props.name: words
props.description: Words to cycle through, in order.

props.name: interval
props.description: Seconds each word stays on screen.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds before the first swap is counted.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
